CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #9
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of The Birth of Moses? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of The Birth of Moses with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use The Birth of Moses to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Birth of Moses.
   D. Say The Birth of Moses has no place in daily life.

2. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Waste food daily

3. Which response best shows understanding of Noah and his sons? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Noah and his sons with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Noah and his sons.
   C. Say Noah and his sons has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Noah and his sons to insult classmates of other faiths.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Work? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Work with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Work to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Work.
   D. Say Work has no place in daily life.

5. Which response best shows understanding of King Solomon the wise ruler? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing King Solomon the wise ruler.
   B. Use King Solomon the wise ruler to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of King Solomon the wise ruler with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say King Solomon the wise ruler has no place in daily life.

6. Which response best shows understanding of A hand writes on the wall? (1 mark)
   A. Use A hand writes on the wall to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing A hand writes on the wall.
   C. Say A hand writes on the wall has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of A hand writes on the wall with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Spreading rumours
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

8. Which response best shows understanding of Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple? (1 mark)
   A. Use Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple.
   C. Apply the teaching of Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Bible Stories: Peter and John in the Temple has no place in daily life.

9. Which response best shows understanding of My purpose Talents and abilities? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of My purpose Talents and abilities with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say My purpose Talents and abilities has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing My purpose Talents and abilities.
   D. Use My purpose Talents and abilities to insult classmates of other faiths.

10. Which response best shows understanding of The Bible as a Guide? (1 mark)
   A. Say The Bible as a Guide has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Bible as a Guide.
   C. Use The Bible as a Guide to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of The Bible as a Guide with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

12. Which response best shows understanding of Family Unity? (1 mark)
   A. Use Family Unity to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Family Unity has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Family Unity.
   D. Apply the teaching of Family Unity with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain The Holy Spirit and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Peter’s miraculous rescue and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Friendship Formation 3 5.2 Human Sexuality 3 5.3 Sanctity of Life 3 5.4 Alcohol, and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Friendship formation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
